description: Na₅ScH₄(C₂O₇)₂ crystallizes in the tetragonal P̅42₁c space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.64 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.28 Å. Sc is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are four shorter (2.21 Å) and four longer (2.22 Å) Sc-O bond lengths. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.26-1.31 Å. H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (0.98 Å) and one longer (1.72 Å) H-O bond length. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sc, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂ScC tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sc, one C, and one H atom.
